```{r}
# Preprocessing (replicated from https://osf.io/47hdb)

hc_data <- read.csv("data/HC_data.csv")
hc_data$constraint <- "high"
hc_data$item_num <- substr(hc_data$code,3,4)
lc_data <- read.csv("data/LC_data.csv")
lc_data$constraint <- "low"
lc_data$item_num <- substr(lc_data$code,3,4)
colnames(lc_data) <- colnames(hc_data)
all_data <- rbind(hc_data,lc_data)

code_levels <- levels(all_data$code)
```

```{r}
# From Morgan et al. (2019) (https://osf.io/wgz9t/), predictions from Temperley-HP with key

# Temperley Hansen-Pearce corpus parameters (with key)
temperley.key.hp <- read.csv("data/hp_logProbabilities_with_keys.csv",header=F)
temperley.key.hp$cond <- substr(temperley.key.hp$V1,1,2)
temperley.key.hp$itemnum<- as.numeric(substr(temperley.key.hp$V1,3,4))
temperley.key.hp$midinum<- as.numeric(substr(temperley.key.hp$V1,6,7))
temperley.key.hp$melody <- with(temperley.key.hp,paste(cond,itemnum,sep=''))
temperley.key.hp$MelodyMidinum <- with(temperley.key.hp,paste(melody,midinum,sep='-'))

temperley_key_hp_preds <- temperley.key.hp %>%
  mutate(prob = exp(V2)) %>%
  select(melody, midinum, prob) %>%
  rename(stem = melody, MIDI = midinum, temperley_hp_key_prob = prob) %>%
  group_by(stem) %>%
  summarise(
    MIDI_max = MIDI[which.max(temperley_hp_key_prob)],
    max_prob = max(temperley_hp_key_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_avg = weighted.mean(MIDI, temperley_hp_key_prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model = "Temperley HP with key")
```

```{r}
# From Morgan et al. (2019) (https://osf.io/wgz9t/), predictions from IDyOM-HP

pitch.data <- read.table("data/25-cpitch-cpintfref%cpint-22_23_24-nil-melody-nil-1-both-nil-t-nil-c-nil-t-t-x-3.dat",sep=" ",header=TRUE)

stem.lens <- read.table("data/melody stem lengths.txt",sep=" ",header=TRUE)
stem.lens$AC01 <- NA
stem.lens$NC01 <- NA
tmp <- as.numeric(stem.lens[1,as.character(pitch.data$melody.name)])
pitch.data$target <- pitch.data$note.id==tmp+1
pitch.data <-subset(pitch.data,target)
  #IDyOM makes predictions for all notes in the melody, we only care about the last one
pitch.data$melody.name <- sapply(pitch.data$melody.name,function(x){sub("AC0?","HC",x)})
pitch.data$melody.name <- sapply(pitch.data$melody.name,function(x){sub("NC0?","LC",x)})

tonics <- rep(pitch.data[match(code_levels[1:45],pitch.data$melody.name),"cpitch"],2)
tonics_list <- as.list(tonics)
names(tonics_list) <- code_levels

idyom_hp_preds <- pitch.data %>%
  mutate(stem = melody.name) %>%
  select(stem, matches("^cpitch\\.[0-9]+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^cpitch\\.[0-9]+$"),
    names_to = "MIDI",
    names_prefix = "cpitch\\.",
    values_to = "idyom_hp_prob"
  ) %>%
  mutate(MIDI = as.integer(MIDI)) %>%
  group_by(stem) %>%
  summarise(
    MIDI_max = MIDI[which.max(idyom_hp_prob)],
    max_prob = max(idyom_hp_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_avg = weighted.mean(MIDI, idyom_hp_prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(model = "IDyOM HP")
```

```{r}
# PMFM model output
pmfm <- read.csv("exports/correlation_full.csv")
pmfm <- pmfm %>% rename(stem = IDs, Human_MIDI = human_means, PMFM_cont_mean = model_means, PMFM_round_mean = rounded_model_means, PMFM_max = max_likelihood_notes)

# convert names

pmfm <- pmfm %>%
  left_join(melody_names, by = c("stem" = "original")) %>%
  mutate(stem = if_else(!is.na(encoded), encoded, stem)) %>%
  select(-c(name_encode, number_encode, name_original, number_original, encoded))

df <- pmfm %>%
  left_join(
    MIDI_centsOff,
    by = "stem"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    temperley_key_hp_preds %>%
      select(stem, MIDI_max, weighted_avg) %>%
      rename(
        TemperleyHP_key_max = MIDI_max,
        TemperleyHP_key_avg = weighted_avg
      ),
    by = "stem"
  ) %>%
  # IDyOM HP
  left_join(
    idyom_hp_preds %>%
      select(stem, MIDI_max, weighted_avg) %>%
      rename(
        IDyOMHP_max = MIDI_max,
        IDyOMHP_avg = weighted_avg
      ),
    by = "stem"
  ) %>%
  rename(Human_cents = MIDI_cents)

df$PMFM_round_max <- round(df$PMFM_max)

shape = read.csv("data/all_keys.csv") %>%
  mutate(stemID = trimws(stemID)) %>%
  left_join(melody_names, by = c("stemID" = "original"))

df = df %>%
  left_join(shape %>% select(encoded, shape), by = c("stem" = "encoded"))

df_lc <- df %>% filter(str_starts(stem, "LC"))
df_hc <- df %>% filter(str_starts(stem, "HC"))
```

```{r}
# Helper function for correlation analyses
print_corr_info <- function(x, y, label = "") {
  res <- cor.test(x, y)
  r <- res$estimate
  r_squared <- r^2
  p_val <- res$p.value
  cat(label, "\n")
  cat(sprintf("  r = %.3f, R^2 = %.3f, p = %.5f\n\n", r, r_squared, p_val))
}

# Full data
cat("Full data\n")
print_corr_info(df$Human_MIDI, df$PMFM_max, "Human vs PMFM (max)")
print_corr_info(df$Human_cents, df$TemperleyHP_key_avg, "Human vs Temperley (avg)")
print_corr_info(df$Human_cents, df$IDyOMHP_avg, "Human vs IDyOM (avg)")

# AC data
cat("AC data\n")
print_corr_info(df_hc$Human_MIDI, df_hc$PMFM_max, "Human vs PMFM (max)")
print_corr_info(df_hc$Human_MIDI, df_hc$TemperleyHP_key_max, "Human vs Temperley (max)")
print_corr_info(df_hc$Human_MIDI, df_hc$IDyOMHP_max, "Human vs IDyOM (max)")

# NC data
cat("NC data\n")
print_corr_info(df_lc$Human_MIDI, df_lc$PMFM_max, "Human vs PMFM (max)")
print_corr_info(df_lc$Human_MIDI, df_lc$TemperleyHP_key_max, "Human vs Temperley (max)")
print_corr_info(df_lc$Human_MIDI, df_lc$IDyOMHP_max, "Human vs IDyOM (max)")
```

```{r}
# Boostrapped correlations via resampling of participant responses
print_corr_info_boot <- function(responses, model_df, label = "", n_boot = 1000, n_samp = 25) {
  res <- cor.test(model_df$x, model_df$Y)
  r <- res$estimate
  r_squared <- r^2
  p_val <- res$p.value
  
  stem_list <- unique(model_df$item)
  boot_corrs <- numeric(n_boot)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    actual_means <- numeric(length(stem_list))
    
    for (j in seq_along(stem_list)) {
      stem <- stem_list[j]
      tmp <- responses %>% filter(item == stem)
      smp <- sample(tmp$MIDI, n_samp, replace = TRUE)
      actual_means[j] <- mean(smp)
    }
    
    boot_corrs[i] <- cor(actual_means, model_df$Y)
  }
  
  boot_mean <- mean(boot_corrs)
  ci <- quantile(boot_corrs, c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  cat(label, "\n")
  cat(sprintf("  r = %.3f, R^2 = %.3f, p = %.4f\n", r, r_squared, p_val))
  cat(sprintf("  Bootstrap mean r = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]\n\n", 
              boot_mean, ci[1], ci[2]))
}

full <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(stem, Human_MIDI, PMFM_round_max) %>%
  rename(item = stem, x = Human_MIDI, Y = PMFM_round_max)

ac <- df_hc %>%
  dplyr::select(stem, Human_MIDI, PMFM_round_max) %>%
  rename(item = stem, x = Human_MIDI, Y = PMFM_round_max)

nc <- df_lc %>%
  dplyr::select(stem, Human_MIDI, PMFM_round_max) %>%
  rename(item = stem, x = Human_MIDI, Y = PMFM_round_max)

cat("Full data\n")
print_corr_info_boot(all_responses, full, "Human vs PMFM")

cat("AC data\n")
print_corr_info_boot(all_responses, ac, "Human vs PMFM (AC)")

cat("NC data\n")
print_corr_info_boot(all_responses, nc, "Human vs PMFM (NC)")
```

## Main correlation plots
```{r}
df$PMFM_round_max <- round(df$PMFM_max)

n_boot <- 1000
boot_cors <- numeric(n_boot)

for (i in 1:n_boot) {
  boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(df), nrow(df), replace = TRUE)
  boot_cors[i] <- cor(df$PMFM_round_max[boot_idx], df$Human_MIDI[boot_idx])
}

boot_mean <- mean(boot_cors)
boot_ci <- quantile(boot_cors, c(0.025, 0.975))

test_result <- cor.test(df$PMFM_round_max, df$Human_MIDI)
r_val <- round(test_result$estimate, 2)
p_val <- signif(test_result$p.value, 1)
r_squared <- round(r_val^2, 2)

print(paste("Correlation r =", r_val, ", p =", p_val, ", R² =", r_squared))
print(paste("Bootstrap mean r =", round(boot_mean, 3)))
print(paste("Bootstrap 95% CI = [", round(boot_ci[1], 3), ",", round(boot_ci[2], 3), "]"))

# Scatterplot of PMFM model vs human responses

full_data <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PMFM_round_max, y = Human_MIDI)) +
                geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
                geom_point(alpha = 1) +
                geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                            color = "blue", fill = "grey") +
                scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(55, 70, by = 3)) +
                scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(55, 70, by = 3)) +
                theme_classic() +
                theme(
                  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
                  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
                  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
                  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)
                ) +
                labs(x = "Model output", y = "Human output")

print(c(r_val, p_val, r_squared))
# save to png
ggsave("plots/full_data.png", plot = full_data, width = 10, height = 6)
```

## Relative importance analyses
```{r}
# Helper function to perform regression decomposition
analyze_model_combo <- function(df, predictors, model_names, combo_name) {
  cat("\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat(sprintf("%-60s\n", paste0(combo_name, " MODEL")))
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  
  # Build formula
  formula_str <- paste("Human_MIDI ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
  m_full <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = df)
  s_full <- summary(m_full)
  
  cat(sprintf("Total R²: %.4f\n", s_full$r.squared))
  cat(sprintf("Adjusted R²: %.4f\n", s_full$adj.r.squared))
  cat(sprintf("F-statistic: %.4f, p-value: %.4e\n\n", 
              s_full$fstatistic[1], 
              pf(s_full$fstatistic[1], s_full$fstatistic[2], s_full$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE)))
  
  if (length(predictors) > 1) {
    # Unique variance (ΔR²)
    cat("---------------- UNIQUE VARIANCE (ΔR²) ----------------\n")
    delta_R2 <- numeric(length(predictors))
    names(delta_R2) <- model_names
    
    for (i in seq_along(predictors)) {
      reduced_predictors <- predictors[-i]
      formula_reduced <- paste("Human_MIDI ~", paste(reduced_predictors, collapse = " + "))
      m_reduced <- lm(as.formula(formula_reduced), data = df)
      delta_R2[i] <- s_full$r.squared - summary(m_reduced)$r.squared
    }
    
    print(round(delta_R2, 4))
    cat("\n% of Total Explained Variance:\n")
    print(round(100 * delta_R2 / s_full$r.squared, 2))
    
    # Partial R²
    cat("\n---------------- PARTIAL R² (Conditional) ----------------\n")
    tvals <- s_full$coefficients[-1, "t value"]
    df_res <- s_full$df[2]
    partial_R2 <- (tvals^2) / (tvals^2 + df_res)
    names(partial_R2) <- model_names
    print(round(partial_R2, 4))
    
    # LMG / Shapley
    cat("\n---------------- LMG / SHAPLEY IMPORTANCE ----------------\n")
    ri <- calc.relimp(m_full, type = "lmg", rela = TRUE)
    print(round(ri$lmg, 4))
    cat("\nProportion of Explained Variance (sums to 1):\n")
    print(round(ri$lmg / sum(ri$lmg), 4))
  } else {
    # Single predictor - just show simple regression stats
    cat("Single predictor model - no decomposition needed\n")
    cat(sprintf("Standardized β: %.4f\n", 
                s_full$coefficients[2, "Estimate"] * sd(df[[predictors]]) / sd(df$Human_MIDI)))
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  return(list(model = m_full, summary = s_full))
}

# Run all combinations
cat("\n\n")
cat(paste(rep("#", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("###", sprintf("%-60s", "FULL MODEL COMPARISON ANALYSIS"), "###\n")
cat(paste(rep("#", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")

# Single-model baselines
analyze_model_combo(df,
                    c("PMFM_round_max"),
                    c("PMFM"),
                    "PMFM ONLY")

analyze_model_combo(df,
                    c("TemperleyHP_key_max"),
                    c("Temperley"),
                    "TEMPERLEY ONLY")

analyze_model_combo(df,
                    c("IDyOMHP_max"),
                    c("IDyOM"),
                    "IDYOM ONLY")

# Two-model combinations
analyze_model_combo(df,
                    c("PMFM_round_max", "TemperleyHP_key_max"),
                    c("PMFM", "Temperley"),
                    "PMFM + TEMPERLEY")

analyze_model_combo(df,
                    c("PMFM_round_max", "IDyOMHP_max"),
                    c("PMFM", "IDyOM"),
                    "PMFM + IDYOM")

analyze_model_combo(df,
                    c("TemperleyHP_key_max", "IDyOMHP_max"),
                    c("Temperley", "IDyOM"),
                    "TEMPERLEY + IDYOM")

# Full three-model combination
analyze_model_combo(df,
                    c("PMFM_round_max", "TemperleyHP_key_max", "IDyOMHP_max"),
                    c("PMFM", "Temperley", "IDyOM"),
                    "FULL (ALL THREE MODELS)")
```

### Contour classification (Huron, 1996)
```{r}
# Objective contour classification following Huron (1996): for each melody,
# the first pitch, last pitch, and the mean of the remaining mid-phrase
# pitches are compared. Ascending: last > mid > first. Descending: the
# reverse. Concave ("u"): first and last pitches both higher than the
# mid-phrase mean. Convex ("arch"): first and last pitches both lower than
# the mid-phrase mean.
melodies_wide <- read.csv("data/all_melodies_final_means.csv")

classify_huron <- function(notes) {
  n <- length(notes)
  first_pitch <- notes[1]
  last_pitch  <- notes[n]
  mid_pitch   <- mean(notes[2:(n - 1)])

  if (last_pitch > mid_pitch && mid_pitch > first_pitch) {
    "ascending"
  } else if (last_pitch < mid_pitch && mid_pitch < first_pitch) {
    "descending"
  } else if (first_pitch > mid_pitch && last_pitch > mid_pitch) {
    "concave"
  } else if (first_pitch < mid_pitch && last_pitch < mid_pitch) {
    "convex"
  } else {
    "other"
  }
}

huron_contours <- lapply(names(melodies_wide), function(col_name) {
  vals <- melodies_wide[[col_name]]
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  notes <- vals[-length(vals)] # drop the trailing human-mean rating
  data.frame(
    stemID = trimws(col_name),
    huron_contour = classify_huron(notes),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(huron_shape = case_when(
    huron_contour %in% c("ascending", "descending") ~ "linear",
    huron_contour == "convex" ~ "arch",
    huron_contour == "concave" ~ "u",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  ))

# Attach the Huron contour categories to the main analysis data frame
# (stemID above is the AC/NC-style name; melody_names maps that to the
# HC/LC-style "stem" identifier used in df)
df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    huron_contours %>%
      left_join(melody_names, by = c("stemID" = "original")) %>%
      select(encoded, huron_contour),
    by = c("stem" = "encoded")
  )
```

### Cadence
```{r}
# Paired bootstrap: all models use the same resampled responses per iteration
bootstrap_r2_paired <- function(responses, df_sub, predictor_sets, n_boot = 1000, n_samp = 25) {
  stem_list <- unique(df_sub$stem)
  model_names <- names(predictor_sets)
  boot_r2s <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_boot, ncol = length(model_names),
                     dimnames = list(NULL, model_names))
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    # Resample ONCE, shared across all models
    human_means <- sapply(stem_list, function(stem) {
      tmp <- responses %>% filter(item == stem)
      mean(sample(tmp$MIDI, n_samp, replace = TRUE))
    })
    boot_df <- df_sub %>%
      mutate(human_mean = human_means[match(stem, stem_list)])
    
    for (model_name in model_names) {
      formula_str <- paste("human_mean ~", paste(predictor_sets[[model_name]], collapse = " + "))
      fit <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = boot_df)
      boot_r2s[i, model_name] <- summary(fit)$r.squared
    }
  }
  boot_r2s
}

subsets <- list(
  Full   = df,
  AC     = df_hc,
  NC     = df_lc
)
predictor_sets <- list(
  PMFM      = "PMFM_round_max",
  Temperley = "TemperleyHP_key_max",
  IDyOM     = "IDyOMHP_max"
)

# Run paired bootstrap for each subset
boot_matrices <- lapply(names(subsets), function(subset_name) {
  cat(sprintf("Running: %s\n", subset_name))
  mat <- bootstrap_r2_paired(all_responses, subsets[[subset_name]], predictor_sets,
                              n_boot = 1000, n_samp = 25)
  list(subset = subset_name, mat = mat)
})
names(boot_matrices) <- names(subsets)

# Rebuild results_r2 from paired matrices
results_r2 <- lapply(names(subsets), function(subset_name) {
  mat <- boot_matrices[[subset_name]]$mat
  lapply(names(predictor_sets), function(model_name) {
    vals <- mat[, model_name]
    data.frame(
      subset = subset_name,
      model  = model_name,
      mean   = mean(vals),
      lo     = quantile(vals, 0.025),
      hi     = quantile(vals, 0.975)
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows()
results_r2$subset <- factor(results_r2$subset, levels = names(subsets))
results_r2$model  <- factor(results_r2$model,  levels = names(predictor_sets))

# Paired p-value: based on per-iteration differences
boot_pval_paired <- function(dist_a, dist_b) {
  diffs <- dist_a - dist_b
  2 * min(mean(diffs > 0), mean(diffs < 0))
}

stars <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else NA
}

get_dist <- function(subset_name, model_name) {
  boot_matrices[[subset_name]]$mat[, model_name]
}

model_offset <- c(PMFM = -0.267, Temperley = 0, IDyOM = 0.267)
model_pairs  <- list(c("PMFM","Temperley"), c("PMFM","IDyOM"), c("Temperley","IDyOM"))
y_steps      <- c(0.04, 0.08, 0.12)

make_annot <- function(subset_names, x_lookup) {
  rows <- list()
  for (sn in subset_names) {
    x_center <- x_lookup[[sn]]
    max_mean <- max(results_r2$hi[results_r2$subset == sn])
    for (k in seq_along(model_pairs)) {
      m1 <- model_pairs[[k]][1]; m2 <- model_pairs[[k]][2]
      p  <- boot_pval_paired(get_dist(sn, m1), get_dist(sn, m2))
      s  <- stars(p)
      if (!is.na(s)) {
        rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
          x     = x_center + model_offset[[m1]],
          xend  = x_center + model_offset[[m2]],
          y     = max_mean + y_steps[k],
          label = s
        )
      }
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
}

cadence_x <- list(AC = 1, NC = 2)

cadence_annot <- make_annot(c("AC", "NC"), cadence_x)

add_brackets <- function(p, annot) {
  if (nrow(annot) == 0) return(p)
  p +
    geom_segment(data = annot, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = annot, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y - 0.005, yend = y), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = annot, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y - 0.005, yend = y), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = annot, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y + 0.008, label = label),
              size = 3.5, family = "Arial")
}

cadence_plot <- add_brackets(
  ggplot(results_r2 %>% filter(subset %in% c("AC", "NC")),
         aes(x = subset, y = mean, fill = model)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("PMFM" = "#1f77b4", "Temperley" = "#ff7f0e", "IDyOM" = "#2ca02c")) +
    labs(x = "Subset", y = expression(R^2), fill = "Model",
         title = "Bootstrapped R² by Cadence Type") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top"),
  cadence_annot
)

ggsave("exports/r2_bootstrap_cadence.png", cadence_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

### Shape (Huron contour categories)
```{r}
# Model-comparison analysis using Huron's (1996) native four-way contour
# classification (ascending, descending, convex, concave), computed earlier
# alongside the manuscript's shape variable.
df_ascending  = df %>% filter(huron_contour == "ascending")
df_descending = df %>% filter(huron_contour == "descending")
df_convex     = df %>% filter(huron_contour == "concave")
df_concave    = df %>% filter(huron_contour == "convex")

run_shape_combo <- function(df_sub, label) {
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(paste(rep("#", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")
  cat("###", sprintf("%-60s", paste(label, "MODEL COMPARISON ANALYSIS")), "###\n")
  cat(paste(rep("#", 70), collapse = ""), "\n")

  # Single-model baselines
  analyze_model_combo(df_sub, c("TemperleyHP_key_max"), c("Temperley"), "TEMPERLEY ONLY")
  analyze_model_combo(df_sub, c("IDyOMHP_max"), c("IDyOM"), "IDYOM ONLY")

  # Two-model combinations
  analyze_model_combo(df_sub, c("PMFM_round_max", "TemperleyHP_key_max"), c("PMFM", "Temperley"), "PMFM + TEMPERLEY")
  analyze_model_combo(df_sub, c("PMFM_round_max", "IDyOMHP_max"), c("PMFM", "IDyOM"), "PMFM + IDYOM")
  analyze_model_combo(df_sub, c("TemperleyHP_key_max", "IDyOMHP_max"), c("Temperley", "IDyOM"), "TEMPERLEY + IDYOM")

  # Full three-model combination
  analyze_model_combo(df_sub, c("PMFM_round_max", "TemperleyHP_key_max", "IDyOMHP_max"), c("PMFM", "Temperley", "IDyOM"), "FULL (ALL THREE MODELS)")
}

run_shape_combo(df_ascending,  "ASCENDING")
run_shape_combo(df_descending, "DESCENDING")
run_shape_combo(df_convex,     "CONVEX")
run_shape_combo(df_concave,    "CONCAVE")
```

```{r}
make_annot_huron <- function(subset_names, x_lookup) {

  ggplot(results_r2_huron,
         aes(x = subset, y = mean, fill = model)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +

                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.0) +

          legend.position = "top"),
  huron_annot

for (sn in names(subsets_huron)) {
  cat("\n", sn, "\n")
  for (pair in model_pairs) {
    m1 <- pair[1]; m2 <- pair[2]
    d1 <- get_dist_huron(sn, m1)
    d2 <- get_dist_huron(sn, m2)
    diffs <- d1 - d2
    n_boot <- length(diffs)
    n_higher <- sum(diffs > 0)
    n_lower  <- sum(diffs < 0)
    n_tied   <- sum(diffs == 0)
    p <- boot_pval_paired(d1, d2)
    sig <- stars(p)

    mean1 <- mean(d1); ci1 <- quantile(d1, c(0.025, 0.975))
    mean2 <- mean(d2); ci2 <- quantile(d2, c(0.025, 0.975))

    cat(sprintf(
      "  %s R2 = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f]\n",
      m1, mean1, ci1[1], ci1[2]
    ))
    cat(sprintf(
      "  %s R2 = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f]\n",
      m2, mean2, ci2[1], ci2[2]
    ))
    cat(sprintf(
      "  %s vs %s: %s higher in %d/%d (%.1f%%), %s higher in %d/%d (%.1f%%), tied %d, mean diff = %.4f, p = %.4f%s\n",
      m1, m2, m1, n_higher, n_boot, 100 * n_higher / n_boot,
      m2, n_lower, n_boot, 100 * n_lower / n_boot,
      n_tied, mean(diffs), p,
      ifelse(is.na(sig), "", paste0(" ", sig))
    ))
  }
}
```

```{r}
 calculate_entropy <- function(particles, n_bins = 20) {
  breaks <- seq(floor(min(particles)), ceiling(max(particles)), 
                length.out = n_bins + 1)
  hist_counts <- hist(particles, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts
  probs <- hist_counts / sum(hist_counts)
  probs <- probs[probs > 0]
  -sum(probs * log2(probs))
}

# Calculate entropy for each stem

print(paired_wilcox_entropy)
cat("\n")

# Sign test
sign_test_entropy <- binom.test(sum(df_wide$LC_higher_entropy, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                 nrow(df_wide), 
                                 p = 0.5)
cat("Sign test (binomial):\n")
print(sign_test_entropy)
cat("\n")

# Paired Cohen's d
paired_cohen_d <- cohen.d(df_wide$entropy_LC, df_wide$entropy_HC, paired = TRUE)
cat("Cohen's d (paired):\n")
print(paired_cohen_d)
cat("\n")

# Pairwise visualizations
p_pairwise_scatter <- ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = entropy_HC, y = entropy_LC)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Pairwise Comparison of Model Entropy",
       subtitle = paste0(sum(df_wide$LC_higher_entropy, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        " of ", nrow(df_wide), 
                        " pairs have LC > HC"),
       x = "Entropy for HC stems (bits)",
       y = "Entropy for LC stems (bits)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

p_pairwise_diff <- ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = stem_number, y = entropy_diff)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = LC_higher_entropy)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#d95f02", "TRUE" = "#1b9e77"),
                    labels = c("HC higher", "LC higher")) +
  labs(title = "Entropy Difference by Stem Pair (LC - HC)",
       x = "Stem Number",
       y = "Entropy Difference (bits)",
       fill = "") +
  theme_classic()

p_pairwise_diff_hist <- ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = entropy_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(df_wide$entropy_diff), 
             linetype = "solid", color = "blue", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Entropy Differences (LC - HC)",
       subtitle = paste0("Mean difference = ", 
                        round(mean(df_wide$entropy_diff), 3), " bits"),
       x = "Entropy Difference (bits)",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()

print(p_pairwise_scatter)
print(p_pairwise_diff)
print(p_pairwise_diff_hist)

cat("\n")
cat("SUMMARY ##################################################################\n")

cat("AGGREGATE ANALYSIS:\n")
```

```{r}
results <- read.csv("exports/coarse_grid_final.csv")

param_cols <- c("σ_gravity", "σ_magnetism", "σ_inertia", "w_g", "w_m", "w_i", "α")

# Generate all upper-triangle pairs
pairs <- combn(param_cols, 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Global color scale
ll_min <- Inf
ll_max <- -Inf
for (pair in pairs) {
  grouped <- results %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(pair))) %>%
    summarise(mean_ll = mean(mean_pred_note_ll), .groups = "drop")
  ll_min <- min(ll_min, grouped$mean_ll)
  ll_max <- max(ll_max, grouped$mean_ll)
}

# Build all plots
plot_list <- lapply(pairs, function(pair) {
  p1 <- pair[1]; p2 <- pair[2]
  
  grouped <- results %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(p1, p2)))) %>%
    summarise(mean_ll = mean(mean_pred_note_ll), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      x_label = factor(round(.data[[p1]], 3)),
      y_label = factor(round(.data[[p2]], 3))
    )
  
  ggplot(grouped, aes(x = x_label, y = y_label, fill = mean_ll)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(ll_min, ll_max)) +
    labs(x = p1, y = p2, title = paste(p1, "vs", p2)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
})

# Save in chunks of 3
for (chunk in 1:7) {
  start_idx <- (chunk - 1) * 3 + 1
  end_idx <- min(chunk * 3, length(plot_list))
  chunk_plots <- plot_list[start_idx:end_idx]
  
  png(paste0("exports/pairwise_heatmaps_predll_", chunk, ".png"),
      width = length(chunk_plots) * 600, height = 600, res = 100)
  grid.arrange(grobs = chunk_plots, nrow = 1)
  dev.off()
}

# Create a dummy plot just to extract the legend
dummy <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, fill = c(ll_min, ll_max)), 
                aes(x = x, y = y, fill = fill)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(ll_min, ll_max),
    name = "Mean Pred. Note LL",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      direction = "horizontal",
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      barwidth = 30,
      barheight = 1.5
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  )

# Extract just the legend
get_legend <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  legend <- g$grobs[[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")]]
  return(legend)
}

legend_grob <- get_legend(dummy)

png("exports/pairwise_heatmaps_legend.png", width = 1800, height = 200, res = 100)
grid.draw(legend_grob)
dev.off()
```

# Essen Corpus Analyses (Temperley & IDyOM)

```{r}
# Temperley original (Essen) corpus parameters (with key)
temperley.key.essen <- read.csv("data/essen_logProbabilities_with_keys.csv",header=F)
temperley.key.essen$cond <- substr(temperley.key.essen$V1,1,2)
temperley.key.essen$itemnum<- as.numeric(substr(temperley.key.essen$V1,3,4))
temperley.key.essen$midinum<- as.numeric(substr(temperley.key.essen$V1,6,7))
temperley.key.essen$melody <- with(temperley.key.essen,paste(cond,itemnum,sep=''))
temperley.key.essen$MelodyMidinum <- with(temperley.key.essen,paste(melody,midinum,sep='-'))

temperley_key_essen_preds <- temperley.key.essen %>%
  mutate(prob = exp(V2)) %>%
  select(melody, midinum, prob) %>%
  rename(stem = melody, MIDI = midinum, temperley_essen_key_prob = prob) %>%
  group_by(stem) %>%
  summarise(
    MIDI_max = MIDI[which.max(temperley_essen_key_prob)],
    max_prob = max(temperley_essen_key_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_avg = weighted.mean(MIDI, temperley_essen_key_prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model = "Temperley Essen with key")
```

```{r}
# IDyOM trained on the Essen corpus, linked viewpoint (cpintfref%cpint)
pitch.data.essen <- read.table("data/25-cpitch-cpintfref%cpint-1_2_3_4_5_6_7_8_9_10_11_12_13_14_15_16_17_18_19_20_21_36-nil-melody-nil-1-both-nil-t-nil-c-nil-t-t-x-3.dat",sep=" ",header=TRUE)

tmp_essen <- as.numeric(stem.lens[1,as.character(pitch.data.essen$melody.name)])
pitch.data.essen$target <- pitch.data.essen$note.id==tmp_essen+1
pitch.data.essen <- subset(pitch.data.essen,target)
  #IDyOM makes predictions for all notes in the melody, we only care about the last one
pitch.data.essen$melody.name <- sapply(pitch.data.essen$melody.name,function(x){sub("AC0?","HC",x)})
pitch.data.essen$melody.name <- sapply(pitch.data.essen$melody.name,function(x){sub("NC0?","LC",x)})

idyom_essen_preds <- pitch.data.essen %>%
  mutate(stem = melody.name) %>%
  select(stem, matches("^cpitch\\.[0-9]+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^cpitch\\.[0-9]+$"),
    names_to = "MIDI",
    names_prefix = "cpitch\\.",
    values_to = "idyom_essen_prob"
  ) %>%
  mutate(MIDI = as.integer(MIDI)) %>%
  group_by(stem) %>%
  summarise(
    MIDI_max = MIDI[which.max(idyom_essen_prob)],
    max_prob = max(idyom_essen_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_avg = weighted.mean(MIDI, idyom_essen_prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model = "IDyOM Essen")
```

```{r}
df_essen <- pmfm %>%
  left_join(
    MIDI_centsOff,
    by = "stem"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    temperley_key_essen_preds %>%
      select(stem, MIDI_max, weighted_avg) %>%
      rename(
        TemperleyEssen_key_max = MIDI_max,
        TemperleyEssen_key_avg = weighted_avg
      ),
    by = "stem"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    idyom_essen_preds %>%
      select(stem, MIDI_max, weighted_avg) %>%
      rename(
        IDyOMEssen_max = MIDI_max,
        IDyOMEssen_avg = weighted_avg
      ),
    by = "stem"
  ) %>%
  rename(Human_cents = MIDI_cents)

df_essen$PMFM_round_max <- round(df_essen$PMFM_max)

df_essen <- df_essen %>%
  left_join(shape %>% select(encoded, shape), by = c("stem" = "encoded"))

df_essen_lc <- df_essen %>% filter(str_starts(stem, "LC"))
df_essen_hc <- df_essen %>% filter(str_starts(stem, "HC"))

df_essen_linear <- df_essen %>% filter(shape == "linear")
df_essen_arch   <- df_essen %>% filter(shape == "arch")
df_essen_u      <- df_essen %>% filter(shape == "u")
```

```{r}
# Paired bootstrap R^2 (Essen), mirroring the HP paired-bootstrap block above
subsets_essen <- list(
  Full   = df_essen,
  AC     = df_essen_hc,
  NC     = df_essen_lc,
  Linear = df_essen_linear,
  Arch   = df_essen_arch,
  U      = df_essen_u
)
predictor_sets_essen <- list(
  PMFM      = "PMFM_round_max",
  Temperley = "TemperleyEssen_key_max",
  IDyOM     = "IDyOMEssen_max"
)

boot_matrices_essen <- lapply(names(subsets_essen), function(subset_name) {
  cat(sprintf("Running: %s\n", subset_name))
  mat <- bootstrap_r2_paired(all_responses, subsets_essen[[subset_name]], predictor_sets_essen,
                              n_boot = 1000, n_samp = 25)
  list(subset = subset_name, mat = mat)
})
names(boot_matrices_essen) <- names(subsets_essen)

results_r2_essen <- lapply(names(subsets_essen), function(subset_name) {
  mat <- boot_matrices_essen[[subset_name]]$mat
  lapply(names(predictor_sets_essen), function(model_name) {
    vals <- mat[, model_name]
    data.frame(
      subset = subset_name,
      model  = model_name,
      mean   = mean(vals),
      lo     = quantile(vals, 0.025),
      hi     = quantile(vals, 0.975)
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows()
results_r2_essen$subset <- factor(results_r2_essen$subset, levels = names(subsets_essen))
results_r2_essen$model  <- factor(results_r2_essen$model,  levels = names(predictor_sets_essen))

get_dist_essen <- function(subset_name, model_name) {
  boot_matrices_essen[[subset_name]]$mat[, model_name]
}

make_annot_essen <- function(subset_names, x_lookup) {
  rows <- list()
  for (sn in subset_names) {
    x_center <- x_lookup[[sn]]
    max_mean <- max(results_r2_essen$hi[results_r2_essen$subset == sn])
    for (k in seq_along(model_pairs)) {
      m1 <- model_pairs[[k]][1]; m2 <- model_pairs[[k]][2]
      p  <- boot_pval_paired(get_dist_essen(sn, m1), get_dist_essen(sn, m2))
      s  <- stars(p)
      if (!is.na(s)) {
        rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
          x     = x_center + model_offset[[m1]],
          xend  = x_center + model_offset[[m2]],
          y     = max_mean + y_steps[k],
          label = s
        )
      }
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
}

shape_x_essen <- list(Linear = 1, Arch = 2, U = 3)

cadence_annot_essen <- make_annot_essen(c("AC", "NC"), cadence_x)
shape_annot_essen   <- make_annot_essen(c("Linear", "Arch", "U"), shape_x_essen)

cadence_plot_essen <- add_brackets(
  ggplot(results_r2_essen %>% filter(subset %in% c("AC", "NC")),
         aes(x = subset, y = mean, fill = model)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("PMFM" = "#1f77b4", "Temperley" = "#ff7f0e", "IDyOM" = "#2ca02c")) +
    labs(x = "Subset", y = expression(R^2), fill = "Model",
         title = "Bootstrapped R² by Cadence Type (Essen Corpus)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top"),
  cadence_annot_essen
)

shape_plot_essen <- add_brackets(
  ggplot(results_r2_essen %>% filter(subset %in% c("Linear", "Arch", "U")),
         aes(x = subset, y = mean, fill = model)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("PMFM" = "#1f77b4", "Temperley" = "#ff7f0e", "IDyOM" = "#2ca02c")) +
    labs(x = "Subset", y = expression(R^2), fill = "Model",
         title = "Bootstrapped R² by Melodic Shape (Essen Corpus)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "top"),
  shape_annot_essen
)

ggsave("exports/r2_bootstrap_cadence_essen.png", cadence_plot_essen, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("exports/r2_bootstrap_shapes_essen.png",  shape_plot_essen,  width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
